The [[Pacnorval Defense Systems, Limited|Pacnorval]] '''sonic dampening helmet''' was designed to protect the wearer against the effects of [[Sonic weapon/Legends|sonic weapons]]. It was light and comfortable, and did not interfere with the wearer's field of vision.<ref name="AE" /> The helmet incorporated [[Vibration-Absorbing Insulation]] and an [[Insulating Harness]] that wrapped around the wearer's neck.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> It did make it hard for the user to hear any other noise also, so it was usually only worn by people who were using sonic weapons.<ref name="AE" />
